<thought>Based on the observed isotopic peaks spaced ~1.003 Da apart with decreasing intensities (100 → 8 → 0.5 → 0.02 → ...), the pattern matches the natural 13C distribution of a carbon‑containing molecule. No characteristic Cl (35/37 ≈ 3:1), Br (1:1), or S (34S ~4%) patterns are present, so only carbon can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
